up: For assay CHEMBL4679970, return the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units for all associated compounds.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays assy JOIN activities a ON assy.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE assy.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649970'
